map.变异系数（CV）怎么看？: How should the coefficient of variation (CV) be read?
map.CV=标准差÷均价×100%，消除了量纲与价格水平的影响，便于不同品种间横向比较: CV = standard deviation ÷ mean × 100% removes the effect of units and price level, making it easy to compare how volatile different products are side by side. A larger CV means a less stable price.
map.套保基准价怎么定？: How should the hedging benchmark price be set?

When the current price is below the mean and an increase is expected, raise the hedging ratio; otherwise lower it.
